method: visible-board one-ply heuristic search, epsilon policies; actual production controller and animation resolver
coordinate_convention: zero-based [row,col,toRow,toCol] swap, [row,col] tap; row zero bottom
assumptions: No purchases, ads, extra moves or external boosts.
